description.relaxed: Minimal automation. Mods handle most issues manually. Good for small, close-knit communities.
description.balanced: Balanced protection with sensible defaults. AutoMod handles common spam; mods handle edge cases.
description.strict: Strong automation. AutoMod actively filters spam, links, invites, and bad words. Verification recommended.
description.lockdown: Maximum protection. All strict features plus aggressive raid defenses. For servers under active attack.

reason.modsDoingWork: Mods are doing most of the work. Consider **one level stricter**.
reason.automodFalsePositives: AutoMod is catching too much. Consider **one level more relaxed**.
reason.raidsDetected: Multiple raids detected. Consider **Strict** and enabling verification.
reason.noChange: Current strictness level is appropriate for this server's activity.

confirm.boost: Boost strictness to **{level}** for **{duration}**? This affects the whole server.
confirm.boostEnd: End the active temporary boost early and return to the configured strictness?

success.boostEnd: Temporary boost ended. Strictness returned to the configured level.

modlog.title: Temporary strictness boost applied
modlog.body:
Case — Strictness boosted to **{level}** for **{duration}** by {moderator}
**Reason:** {reason}
modlog.boostEnded: Temporary strictness boost ended early by {moderator}.

error.notInServer: This command can only be used in a server.
error.invalidDuration: Invalid duration. Use a value like 15m, 2h, 1d (15 minutes to 24 hours).
error.missingPermissions: My highest role must be above yours to apply a server-wide boost.
error.noActiveBoost: There is no active temporary boost to end.
error.endFailed: Failed to end the temporary boost.

suggestion.title: Server Size Change Detected
suggestion.up: Your server grew to **{count} members** 🎉. I'd suggest switching from **{from}** to **{to}** protection.
suggestion.down: Your server size changed to **{count} members**. Consider switching from **{from}** to **{to}** protection.
